hero.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original wide hero artwork for the standalone multiplayer web game Neon Heist. Primary request: cinematic, realistic 3D-rendered cyberpunk heist imagery with the detail and materials of a polished game character render. Scene: a rain-soaked futuristic city rooftop at night, blurred neon architecture and amber light strips, dark teal atmospheric haze. Subject: a single original hooded cyberpunk hacker operative, waist-up three-quarter view, sculpted charcoal technical hood, layered black leather and ballistic-fabric jacket, subtle teal cybernetic visor/implant, hands close to chest holding a compact hacking device. Composition: wide 16:9 landscape. Operative occupies the center-right, large and clearly readable, with spacious very dark negative space on the left for actual HTML typography. Keep far right darker too for a UI panel overlay. Lighting: dramatic cyan-teal rim light on hood, warm amber-orange practical light from below, physically based materials, cinematic depth of field, fine rain detail. Mood: tense, premium, restrained. Constraints: original character, no text, no logos, no watermarks, no workstation or monitor, no UI embedded in the image; this is artwork for the actual game. High detail face partly shadowed but natural anatomy.

crew.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single game portrait atlas texture containing six original cyberpunk operatives, for Neon Heist cards. Create one landscape image with exactly 3 equal columns and 2 equal rows: six perfectly aligned square panels, no gaps and no gutters. Each panel is a premium realistic 3D game character bust portrait, centered head and shoulders, consistent camera framing, detailed physically based dark clothing, near-black teal background, dramatic cyan rim light and warm amber fill light. Top-left: Ghost, young hooded hacker with a subtle cyan cybernetic visor and black technical hood, face visible partly shadowed. Top-middle: Brute, muscular broad-shouldered black male enforcer in dark industrial armor with amber highlights. Top-right: Wraith, female stealth operative wearing a dark violet hood and sleek armor, a half-mask. Bottom-left: Switch, stylish androgynous grifter with short swept-back silver hair, fitted burgundy coat, knowing smile. Bottom-middle: Rook, female getaway driver in black moto jacket with blue shoulder accents and dark goggles pushed up above forehead. Bottom-right: Oracle, older male analyst with salt-and-pepper beard, a high-collar charcoal coat and gold cybernetic temple implant. Style: original cinematic cyberpunk characters, restrained moody photorealistic 3D rendering. Critical composition: each character must remain completely inside their own equal square panel with the face centered; the six panels form a precise regular 3-by-2 atlas that will be cropped using CSS. No text, no names, no numbering, no logos, no watermarks, no UI, no borders. Not cartoon. Do not combine or overlap panels.
